finding.claim: Lobby join password/checksum/joinable gate is not enforced: 'return' inside WithReadLock closure only exits the closure, so the attacker is still added as a peer.
finding.source: Authenticated session (sessionID) plus request fields password, AppBinaryChecksum, DataChecksum, ModDllFile, ModVersion, VersionFlags (join.go:37-41).

trace.note: Removes user from existing match before validation
return exits only the closure, not Join
Execution continues; WithWriteLock then UnsafeNewPeer adds the peer
Second JSON body written after the error body

finding.guards_checked: Session middleware (sessionMiddleware.go:22-36) requires a valid session. Party check (join.go:65-68). Read lock. None of these stop the peer insertion after the closure returns.

finding.claim: PlayFab login creates a session for any existing user from an unauthenticated client-supplied integer ID or SteamID, bypassing all credential checks.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST body field CustomId (LoginWithCustomID.go:16-18) or SteamTicket hex (LoginWithSteam.go:38-40, steamAppTicket.go:28).
finding.sink: sessions.CreateWithUserId / CreateWithSteamUserId returns an entity token used for inventory and CloudScript access.

trace.note: LoginWithCustomID and LoginWithSteam are in playAnonymousPaths
CreateWithUserId issues token for that user
Decodes SteamID from hex; no signature verification
CreateWithSteamUserId issues token for matched user

finding.guards_checked: None on identity. The Authentication config (root.go:100-107, game.go:94) is applied only to the game login path, not PlayFab. Lookup fails closed for unknown users (session.go:62-68), so only existing users can be impersonated.

finding.claim: Mission rewards are granted on a client-asserted Won flag, and start/award can be repeated indefinitely, so rewards can be farmed without playing.
finding.source: CloudScript FunctionParameter.Won and MissionId (awardMissionRewards.go:14-18), and MissionId in StartGauntletMission (startGauntletMission.go:11-14).

trace.note: Client MissionId stored as MissionBeingPlayedRightNow with no validation
MissionId split on '_'; elements[1] panics if absent
Equality check satisfied by the attacker's own prior start call
Mission cleared; start can be repeated

finding.guards_checked: PlayFab token check (playfabapiMiddleware.go:24-41). MissionBeingPlayedRightNow equality (awardMissionRewards.go:47). Mission must exist in labyrinth for rewards (52-54). No check against already-completed missions, no server-side outcome, no rate limit.

finding.claim: Any session can modify any advertisement (lobby), including its password and state, because no host or peer ownership check is made.
finding.source: Authenticated session plus request body q.Id and advertisement fields (update.go:24-28).
finding.guards_checked: Session middleware only. No check that the requester is adv.hostId or a peer.

finding.source: Authenticated session plus advertisementid and state from request (updateState.go:14-17).
finding.sink: UnsafeUpdateState to state 1 (updateState.go:41) and wss.SendOrStoreMessage MatchStartMessage to peers (updateState.go:72-85).

trace.note: GetAdvertisement by client-supplied id, no ownership check

finding.claim: Session IDs and cloudfiles signatures derive from a PCG seeded by a 64-bit wall-clock nanosecond value, so they are guessable within a startup-time window.
finding.source: Startup time (root.go:110) fixes the RNG seed; attacker observes issued session IDs or signatures.
finding.sink: Session IDs (session.go:22-30), cloudfiles signatures (credentials.go:13-22) used for auth and /cloudfiles/ access (sessionMiddleware.go:22, cloudfiles.go:37).

trace.note: rand.NewPCG(seed, seed): 64 bits of effective entropy
30-char session ID drawn from the PRNG
/cloudfiles/ bypasses session check; sig is the only gate

finding.guards_checked: Session expiry (5 min), sweeper, credential expiry (5 min). PCG is not a CSPRNG and the seed is recoverable. Exploit not run; search cost depends on how well startup time is bounded.

finding.claim: Cached-auth offline fallback lets anyone impersonate a user by platform ID during upstream failure, with no proof of identity.
finding.source: Client-supplied platformUserID in login body; upstream non-200 or transport error (authMiddleware.go:101-109).
finding.sink: AuthMiddlewareOffline next handler (authMiddleware.go:38-41) logs in the user matched by platformUserID (loginMiddleware.go:28-37).

trace.note: errorHandler: cached mode falls back to offline
Offline check: deadline in future, no secret
Deadline set on prior upstream success, 30 days (line 27)

finding.guards_checked: Upstream verification on success path. Error-code path (128-131) correctly does not fall back. Fallback has no proof of identity.

finding.claim: Unbounded goroutine growth: undeliverable messages spawn goroutines that block forever on a full 100-slot channel, so a logged-in user can exhaust memory by flooding another user.
finding.source: Any logged-in user sends whispers (sendWhisper.go:53-98) to a target who has a session but no websocket.
finding.sink: Blocking channel send in SessionData.AddMessage (session.go:51-53) inside goroutine (wss.go:340-344).

trace.note: Recipient list from client, no cap
Blocking send into cap-100 channel, no select

finding.guards_checked: Session required (sessionMiddleware.go). Recipients must be existing users. No rate limit or message cap found in this path.

finding.claim: Platform login identity is client-asserted when Authentication is 'disabled' (the default), so anyone can log in as any platform user ID.
finding.sink: GetOrCreateUser keyed on client ID (loginMiddleware.go:28-37) and sessions.Create (platformlogin.go:39).

trace.note: Existing session for that user deleted

finding.guards_checked: Authentication mode (game.go:94). Default is 'disabled' per config.toml:14 and root.go:330, documented as intentional.
